notizie.titolo: Commission decides to refer Greece to the Court of Justice of the European Union for the non-implementation of individual aircraft identification in the field of civil aviation
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission decided to refer Greece (INFR(2024)2237) to the Court of Justice of the European Union for failing to implement the required aircraft identification technology, as mandated by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/373, which governs air traffic management and navigation services.

notizie.titolo: Commission decides to refer Austria to the Court of Justice of the European Union for incorrectly applying the European arrest warrant
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission decided to refer Austria (INFR(2020)2307) to the Court of Justice of the European Union for failing to comply with the Framework Decision on the European Arrest Warrant (2002/584/JHA).
